description.value: Murchie's is Canada's oldest tea company, founded in Victoria in 1894, and its Downtown Government Street flagship pairs a full retail store with a sit-down café serving the company's own in-house blended teas and freshly roasted 100% Arabica coffees. The heritage brand has operated continuously for over 130 years and is a well-known landmark on one of Victoria's busiest pedestrian and cycling corridors. The combined retail-and-café format means cyclists can grab a drink, browse loose-leaf teas, and pick up supplies in a single stop.
